changeSet.author: credesal
changeSet.comment: Register the direct-method cash-flow statement, its exception diagnostic, and approval-gated accounting configuration for every upgraded tenant.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS credesal_cash_flow_cash_account ( gl_account_id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES acc_gl_account(id), active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, rationale TEXT NOT NULL, approved_by VARCHAR(100), approved_on DATE, created_on TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CHECK ((approved_by IS NULL) = (approved_on IS NULL)), CHECK (NOT active OR (approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_on IS NOT NULL)) );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS credesal_cash_flow_mapping ( gl_account_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES acc_gl_account(id), cash_direction CHAR(1) NOT NULL, section_code VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, line_code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, line_label VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, line_order INTEGER NOT NULL, active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE, rationale TEXT NOT NULL, approved_by VARCHAR(100), approved_on DATE, created_on TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (gl_account_id, cash_direction), CHECK (cash_direction IN ('I', 'O')), CHECK (section_code IN ('OPERATING', 'INVESTING', 'FINANCING')), CHECK (line_order BETWEEN 0 AND 98), CHECK ((approved_by IS NULL) = (approved_on IS NULL)), CHECK (NOT active OR (approved_by IS NOT NULL AND approved_on IS NOT NULL)) );
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_credesal_cash_flow_mapping_line ON credesal_cash_flow_mapping (section_code, line_order, line_code) WHERE active;
INSERT INTO stretchy_report ( report_name, report_type, report_subtype, report_category, report_sql, description, core_report, use_report, self_service_user_report ) VALUES ( 'Estado de Flujo de Efectivo', 'Table', NULL, 'Accounting', $report$ WITH RECURSIVE selected_offices AS ( SELECT office_under.id FROM m_office selected_office JOIN m_office office_under ON office_under.hierarchy LIKE selected_office.hierarchy || '%' WHERE selected_office.id = CAST('${officeId}' AS BIGINT) AND office_under.hierarchy LIKE '${currentUserHierarchy}' || '%' ), cash_account_tree AS ( SELECT configured.gl_account_id AS root_account_id, configured.gl_account_id AS account_id, ARRAY[configured.gl_account_id]::BIGINT[] AS account_path FROM credesal_cash_flow_cash_account configured WHERE configured.active
UNION ALL
SELECT tree.root_account_id, child.id, tree.account_path || child.id FROM cash_account_tree tree JOIN acc_gl_account child ON child.parent_id = tree.account_id WHERE NOT child.id = ANY(tree.account_path) ), cash_accounts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM cash_account_tree ), account_ancestry AS ( SELECT account.id AS descendant_account_id, account.id AS ancestor_account_id, 0 AS distance, ARRAY[account.id]::BIGINT[] AS account_path FROM acc_gl_account account
UNION ALL
SELECT ancestry.descendant_account_id, parent.id, ancestry.distance + 1, ancestry.account_path || parent.id FROM account_ancestry ancestry JOIN acc_gl_account child ON child.id = ancestry.ancestor_account_id JOIN acc_gl_account parent ON parent.id = child.parent_id WHERE NOT parent.id = ANY(ancestry.account_path) ), scoped_journal AS ( SELECT journal.id, journal.transaction_id, journal.ref_num, journal.entry_date, journal.office_id, journal.account_id, journal.type_enum, journal.amount, journal.description FROM acc_gl_journal_entry journal WHERE journal.currency_code = 'USD' AND journal.office_id IN (SELECT id FROM selected_offices) AND journal.entry_date <= CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) ), cash_balances AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN journal.entry_date < CAST('${startDate}' AS DATE) THEN CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 2 THEN journal.amount ELSE -journal.amount END ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS opening_cash, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN journal.entry_date BETWEEN CAST('${startDate}' AS DATE) AND CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) THEN CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 2 THEN journal.amount ELSE -journal.amount END ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS period_cash_change, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 2 THEN journal.amount ELSE -journal.amount END), 0.00) AS closing_cash FROM scoped_journal journal WHERE journal.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM cash_accounts) ), period_journal AS ( SELECT * FROM scoped_journal WHERE entry_date BETWEEN CAST('${startDate}' AS DATE) AND CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) ), cash_transactions AS ( SELECT journal.transaction_id, journal.office_id, journal.entry_date, MIN(journal.ref_num) AS ref_num, SUM(CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 2 THEN journal.amount ELSE -journal.amount END) AS net_cash_change FROM period_journal journal WHERE journal.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM cash_accounts) GROUP BY journal.transaction_id, journal.office_id, journal.entry_date HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 2 THEN journal.amount ELSE -journal.amount END) <> 0.00 ), counterpart_candidates AS ( SELECT cash.transaction_id, cash.office_id, cash.entry_date, cash.ref_num, cash.net_cash_change, journal.id AS journal_entry_id, journal.account_id AS counterpart_account_id, journal.amount AS counterpart_amount, journal.description FROM cash_transactions cash JOIN period_journal journal ON journal.transaction_id = cash.transaction_id AND journal.office_id = cash.office_id AND journal.entry_date = cash.entry_date WHERE journal.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM cash_accounts) AND ((cash.net_cash_change > 0.00 AND journal.type_enum = 1) OR (cash.net_cash_change < 0.00 AND journal.type_enum = 2)) ), candidate_totals AS ( SELECT cash.transaction_id, cash.office_id, cash.entry_date, cash.ref_num, cash.net_cash_change, COALESCE(SUM(candidate.counterpart_amount), 0.00) AS candidate_total FROM cash_transactions cash LEFT JOIN counterpart_candidates candidate ON candidate.transaction_id = cash.transaction_id AND candidate.office_id = cash.office_id AND candidate.entry_date = cash.entry_date GROUP BY cash.transaction_id, cash.office_id, cash.entry_date, cash.ref_num, cash.net_cash_change ), valid_components AS ( SELECT candidate.transaction_id, candidate.office_id, candidate.entry_date, candidate.ref_num, candidate.journal_entry_id, candidate.counterpart_account_id, account.gl_code AS counterpart_gl_code, account.name AS counterpart_name, CASE WHEN candidate.net_cash_change > 0.00 THEN 'I' ELSE 'O' END AS cash_direction, CASE WHEN candidate.net_cash_change > 0.00 THEN candidate.counterpart_amount ELSE -candidate.counterpart_amount END AS net_amount, mapping.section_code, mapping.line_code, mapping.line_label, mapping.line_order, CASE WHEN mapping.gl_account_id IS NULL THEN 'UNMAPPED' ELSE 'MAPPED' END AS classification_status FROM counterpart_candidates candidate JOIN candidate_totals totals ON totals.transaction_id = candidate.transaction_id AND totals.office_id = candidate.office_id AND totals.entry_date = candidate.entry_date AND totals.candidate_total = ABS(totals.net_cash_change) JOIN acc_gl_account account ON account.id = candidate.counterpart_account_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT configured.gl_account_id, configured.section_code, configured.line_code, configured.line_label, configured.line_order FROM account_ancestry ancestry JOIN credesal_cash_flow_mapping configured ON configured.gl_account_id = ancestry.ancestor_account_id WHERE ancestry.descendant_account_id = candidate.counterpart_account_id AND configured.cash_direction = CASE WHEN candidate.net_cash_change > 0.00 THEN 'I' ELSE 'O' END AND configured.active ORDER BY ancestry.distance, configured.gl_account_id LIMIT 1 ) mapping ON TRUE ), ambiguous_components AS ( SELECT totals.transaction_id, totals.office_id, totals.entry_date, totals.ref_num, NULL::BIGINT AS journal_entry_id, NULL::BIGINT AS counterpart_account_id, NULL::VARCHAR AS counterpart_gl_code, NULL::VARCHAR AS counterpart_name, CASE WHEN totals.net_cash_change > 0.00 THEN 'I' ELSE 'O' END AS cash_direction, totals.net_cash_change AS net_amount, NULL::VARCHAR AS section_code, 'AMBIGUOUS'::VARCHAR AS line_code, 'Movimientos ambiguos pendientes de clasificación'::VARCHAR AS line_label, 9999 AS line_order, 'AMBIGUOUS'::VARCHAR AS classification_status FROM candidate_totals totals WHERE totals.candidate_total <> ABS(totals.net_cash_change) ), flow_components AS ( SELECT * FROM valid_components UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ambiguous_components ), report_lines AS ( SELECT COALESCE(component.section_code, 'UNCLASSIFIED') AS section_code, COALESCE(component.line_code, 'UNMAPPED') AS line_code, COALESCE(component.line_label, 'Movimientos sin mapeo contable') AS line_label, COALESCE(component.line_order, 9999) AS line_order, COUNT(DISTINCT (component.transaction_id, component.office_id, component.entry_date)) AS movement_count, SUM(CASE WHEN component.net_amount > 0.00 THEN component.net_amount ELSE 0.00 END) AS inflows, SUM(CASE WHEN component.net_amount < 0.00 THEN -component.net_amount ELSE 0.00 END) AS outflows, SUM(component.net_amount) AS net_amount, CASE WHEN BOOL_AND(component.classification_status = 'MAPPED') THEN 'CLASIFICADO' ELSE 'REQUIERE CLASIFICACION' END AS status FROM flow_components component GROUP BY COALESCE(component.section_code, 'UNCLASSIFIED'), COALESCE(component.line_code, 'UNMAPPED'), COALESCE(component.line_label, 'Movimientos sin mapeo contable'), COALESCE(component.line_order, 9999) ), sections(section_code, section_label, section_order) AS ( VALUES ('OPERATING', 'ACTIVIDADES DE OPERACIÓN', 100), ('INVESTING', 'ACTIVIDADES DE INVERSIÓN', 200), ('FINANCING', 'ACTIVIDADES DE FINANCIAMIENTO', 300) ), section_totals AS ( SELECT section.section_code, section.section_label, section.section_order, COALESCE(SUM(line.movement_count), 0) AS movement_count, COALESCE(SUM(line.inflows), 0.00) AS inflows, COALESCE(SUM(line.outflows), 0.00) AS outflows, COALESCE(SUM(line.net_amount), 0.00) AS net_amount FROM sections section LEFT JOIN report_lines line ON line.section_code = section.section_code GROUP BY section.section_code, section.section_label, section.section_order ), statement_change AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_amount), 0.00) AS amount FROM flow_components ), classification_control AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE classification_status = 'UNMAPPED') AS unmapped_components, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE classification_status = 'AMBIGUOUS') AS ambiguous_transactions FROM flow_components ), output_rows AS ( SELECT 10 AS row_order, 'CONTROL'::TEXT AS row_type, 'EFECTIVO'::TEXT AS section_label, 'OPENING_CASH'::TEXT AS line_code, 'Efectivo y equivalentes al inicio del período'::TEXT AS concept, 0::BIGINT AS movement_count, NULL::NUMERIC AS inflows, NULL::NUMERIC AS outflows, balances.opening_cash AS net_amount, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credesal_cash_flow_cash_account WHERE active) THEN 'CONFIGURADO' ELSE 'CONFIGURACION REQUERIDA' END AS status FROM cash_balances balances
UNION ALL
SELECT section.section_order + line.line_order, 'DETALLE', section.section_label, line.line_code, line.line_label, line.movement_count, line.inflows, line.outflows, line.net_amount, line.status FROM sections section JOIN report_lines line ON line.section_code = section.section_code
UNION ALL
SELECT section.section_order + 99, 'SUBTOTAL', section.section_label, 'SUBTOTAL_' || section.section_code, 'Flujo neto de ' || lower(section.section_label), section.movement_count, section.inflows, section.outflows, section.net_amount, 'CALCULADO' FROM section_totals section
UNION ALL
SELECT 400 + line.line_order, 'DETALLE', 'SIN CLASIFICAR', line.line_code, line.line_label, line.movement_count, line.inflows, line.outflows, line.net_amount, line.status FROM report_lines line WHERE line.section_code = 'UNCLASSIFIED'
UNION ALL
SELECT 900, 'CONTROL', 'EFECTIVO', 'NET_CHANGE', 'Aumento (disminución) neto de efectivo', 0, NULL, NULL, change.amount, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credesal_cash_flow_cash_account WHERE active) THEN 'CONFIGURACION REQUERIDA' WHEN control.unmapped_components = 0 AND control.ambiguous_transactions = 0 THEN 'CLASIFICACION COMPLETA' ELSE 'REQUIERE CLASIFICACION' END FROM statement_change change CROSS JOIN classification_control control
UNION ALL
SELECT 910, 'CONTROL', 'EFECTIVO', 'CLOSING_CASH', 'Efectivo y equivalentes al final del período', 0, NULL, NULL, balances.closing_cash, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credesal_cash_flow_cash_account WHERE active) THEN 'CALCULADO' ELSE 'CONFIGURACION REQUERIDA' END FROM cash_balances balances
UNION ALL
SELECT 920, 'CONTROL', 'CONCILIACIÓN', 'RECONCILIATION_DIFFERENCE', 'Diferencia de conciliación', 0, NULL, NULL, balances.closing_cash - balances.opening_cash - change.amount, CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credesal_cash_flow_cash_account WHERE active) THEN 'CONFIGURACION REQUERIDA' WHEN balances.closing_cash - balances.opening_cash - change.amount = 0.00 THEN 'CONCILIADO' ELSE 'ERROR DE CONCILIACION' END FROM cash_balances balances CROSS JOIN statement_change change ) SELECT row_type AS "Tipo", section_label AS "Sección", line_code AS "Código", concept AS "Concepto", movement_count AS "Movimientos", ROUND(inflows, 2) AS "Entradas", ROUND(outflows, 2) AS "Salidas", ROUND(net_amount, 2) AS "Flujo Neto", status AS "Estado" FROM output_rows ORDER BY row_order, line_code $report$, 'Estado directo de flujos de efectivo con conciliación y clasificación explícita.', FALSE, TRUE, FALSE ) ON CONFLICT (report_name) DO UPDATE SET report_type = EXCLUDED.report_type, report_subtype = EXCLUDED.report_subtype, report_category = EXCLUDED.report_category, report_sql = EXCLUDED.report_sql, description = EXCLUDED.description, core_report = EXCLUDED.core_report, use_report = EXCLUDED.use_report, self_service_user_report = EXCLUDED.self_service_user_report;
INSERT INTO stretchy_report ( report_name, report_type, report_subtype, report_category, report_sql, description, core_report, use_report, self_service_user_report ) VALUES ( 'Diagnóstico de Flujo de Efectivo', 'Table', NULL, 'Accounting', $diagnostic$ WITH RECURSIVE selected_offices AS ( SELECT office_under.id FROM m_office selected_office JOIN m_office office_under ON office_under.hierarchy LIKE selected_office.hierarchy || '%' WHERE selected_office.id = CAST('${officeId}' AS BIGINT) AND office_under.hierarchy LIKE '${currentUserHierarchy}' || '%' ), cash_account_tree AS ( SELECT configured.gl_account_id AS account_id, ARRAY[configured.gl_account_id]::BIGINT[] AS account_path FROM credesal_cash_flow_cash_account configured WHERE configured.active UNION ALL SELECT child.id, tree.account_path || child.id FROM cash_account_tree tree JOIN acc_gl_account child ON child.parent_id = tree.account_id WHERE NOT child.id = ANY(tree.account_path) ), cash_accounts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM cash_account_tree ), account_ancestry AS ( SELECT account.id AS descendant_account_id, account.id AS ancestor_account_id, 0 AS distance, ARRAY[account.id]::BIGINT[] AS account_path FROM acc_gl_account account UNION ALL SELECT ancestry.descendant_account_id, parent.id, ancestry.distance + 1, ancestry.account_path || parent.id FROM account_ancestry ancestry JOIN acc_gl_account child ON child.id = ancestry.ancestor_account_id JOIN acc_gl_account parent ON parent.id = child.parent_id WHERE NOT parent.id = ANY(ancestry.account_path) ), period_journal AS ( SELECT journal.* FROM acc_gl_journal_entry journal WHERE journal.currency_code = 'USD' AND journal.office_id IN (SELECT id FROM selected_offices) AND journal.entry_date BETWEEN CAST('${startDate}' AS DATE) AND CAST('${endDate}' AS DATE) ), cash_transactions AS ( SELECT journal.transaction_id, journal.office_id, journal.entry_date, MIN(journal.ref_num) AS ref_num, SUM(CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 2 THEN journal.amount ELSE -journal.amount END) AS net_cash_change FROM period_journal journal WHERE journal.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM cash_accounts) GROUP BY journal.transaction_id, journal.office_id, journal.entry_date HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN journal.type_enum = 2 THEN journal.amount ELSE -journal.amount END) <> 0.00 ), candidates AS ( SELECT cash.*, journal.id AS journal_entry_id, journal.account_id AS counterpart_account_id, journal.amount AS counterpart_amount, journal.description FROM cash_transactions cash JOIN period_journal journal ON journal.transaction_id = cash.transaction_id AND journal.office_id = cash.office_id AND journal.entry_date = cash.entry_date WHERE journal.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM cash_accounts) AND ((cash.net_cash_change > 0.00 AND journal.type_enum = 1) OR (cash.net_cash_change < 0.00 AND journal.type_enum = 2)) ), totals AS ( SELECT cash.transaction_id, cash.office_id, cash.entry_date, cash.ref_num, cash.net_cash_change, COALESCE(SUM(candidate.counterpart_amount), 0.00) AS candidate_total FROM cash_transactions cash LEFT JOIN candidates candidate ON candidate.transaction_id = cash.transaction_id AND candidate.office_id = cash.office_id AND candidate.entry_date = cash.entry_date GROUP BY cash.transaction_id, cash.office_id, cash.entry_date, cash.ref_num, cash.net_cash_change ), candidate_diagnostics AS ( SELECT candidate.entry_date, office.name AS office_name, candidate.transaction_id, candidate.ref_num, candidate.net_cash_change, totals.candidate_total, account.gl_code, account.name AS account_name, candidate.counterpart_amount, candidate.description, mapping.section_code, mapping.line_code, CASE WHEN totals.candidate_total <> ABS(candidate.net_cash_change) THEN 'AMBIGUOUS' WHEN mapping.gl_account_id IS NULL THEN 'UNMAPPED' ELSE 'MAPPED' END AS diagnostic_status FROM candidates candidate JOIN totals ON totals.transaction_id = candidate.transaction_id AND totals.office_id = candidate.office_id AND totals.entry_date = candidate.entry_date JOIN m_office office ON office.id = candidate.office_id JOIN acc_gl_account account ON account.id = candidate.counterpart_account_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT configured.gl_account_id, configured.section_code, configured.line_code FROM account_ancestry ancestry JOIN credesal_cash_flow_mapping configured ON configured.gl_account_id = ancestry.ancestor_account_id WHERE ancestry.descendant_account_id = candidate.counterpart_account_id AND configured.cash_direction = CASE WHEN candidate.net_cash_change > 0.00 THEN 'I' ELSE 'O' END AND configured.active ORDER BY ancestry.distance, configured.gl_account_id LIMIT 1 ) mapping ON TRUE ), missing_candidate_diagnostics AS ( SELECT totals.entry_date, office.name AS office_name, totals.transaction_id, totals.ref_num, totals.net_cash_change, totals.candidate_total, NULL::VARCHAR AS gl_code, NULL::VARCHAR AS account_name, NULL::NUMERIC AS counterpart_amount, NULL::VARCHAR AS description, NULL::VARCHAR AS section_code, NULL::VARCHAR AS line_code, 'AMBIGUOUS'::VARCHAR AS diagnostic_status FROM totals JOIN m_office office ON office.id = totals.office_id WHERE totals.candidate_total = 0.00 ) SELECT diagnostic.entry_date AS "Fecha", diagnostic.office_name AS "Oficina", diagnostic.transaction_id AS "Transacción", diagnostic.ref_num AS "Referencia", ROUND(diagnostic.net_cash_change, 2) AS "Cambio en Efectivo", ROUND(diagnostic.candidate_total, 2) AS "Total Contrapartidas", diagnostic.gl_code AS "Cuenta Contrapartida", diagnostic.account_name AS "Nombre Cuenta", ROUND(diagnostic.counterpart_amount, 2) AS "Monto Contrapartida", diagnostic.description AS "Descripción", diagnostic.section_code AS "Sección Mapeada", diagnostic.line_code AS "Línea Mapeada", diagnostic.diagnostic_status AS "Diagnóstico" FROM ( SELECT * FROM candidate_diagnostics UNION ALL SELECT * FROM missing_candidate_diagnostics ) diagnostic WHERE diagnostic.diagnostic_status <> 'MAPPED' ORDER BY diagnostic.entry_date, diagnostic.transaction_id, diagnostic.gl_code $diagnostic$, 'Movimientos de efectivo ambiguos o sin mapeo contable.', FALSE, TRUE, FALSE ) ON CONFLICT (report_name) DO UPDATE SET report_type = EXCLUDED.report_type, report_subtype = EXCLUDED.report_subtype, report_category = EXCLUDED.report_category, report_sql = EXCLUDED.report_sql, description = EXCLUDED.description, core_report = EXCLUDED.core_report, use_report = EXCLUDED.use_report, self_service_user_report = EXCLUDED.self_service_user_report;
DELETE FROM stretchy_report_parameter WHERE report_id IN ( SELECT id FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name IN ('Estado de Flujo de Efectivo', 'Diagnóstico de Flujo de Efectivo') );
INSERT INTO stretchy_report_parameter ( report_id, parameter_id, report_parameter_name ) SELECT report.id, parameter.id, parameter.parameter_variable FROM stretchy_report report CROSS JOIN stretchy_parameter parameter WHERE report.report_name IN ('Estado de Flujo de Efectivo', 'Diagnóstico de Flujo de Efectivo') AND parameter.parameter_name IN ('OfficeIdSelectOne', 'startDateSelect', 'endDateSelect');
DO $validation$ DECLARE report_name_to_check TEXT; BEGIN FOREACH report_name_to_check IN ARRAY ARRAY[ 'Estado de Flujo de Efectivo', 'Diagnóstico de Flujo de Efectivo' ] LOOP IF ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report_parameter usage JOIN stretchy_report report ON report.id = usage.report_id WHERE report.report_name = report_name_to_check AND usage.report_parameter_name IN ('officeId', 'startDate', 'endDate') ) <> 3 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '% requires officeId, startDate, and endDate parameters', report_name_to_check; END IF; END LOOP; END $validation$;
INSERT INTO m_permission ( grouping, code, entity_name, action_name, can_maker_checker ) SELECT 'report', 'READ_' || report_name, report_name, 'READ', FALSE FROM (VALUES ('Estado de Flujo de Efectivo'), ('Diagnóstico de Flujo de Efectivo') ) reports(report_name) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_permission permission WHERE permission.code = 'READ_' || reports.report_name );
